product_updates.title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
product_updates.content: Abliteration.AI is making powerful AI models without guardrails easier to access, arguing that giving defenders the same tools as bad actors could ultimately improve cybersecurity.

product_updates.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
product_updates.content: For its new Muse Spark model, intended for operating coding and other agents, Meta is offering an explicit discount averaging out to about 95% for users who "contribute" to the development of future models by sharing their prompts and model outputs.

product_updates.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
product_updates.content: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."

product_updates.title: Ollie is betting its focus on privacy can help it win the AI assistant race
product_updates.content: The family-focused AI assistant wants access to the details of your everyday life, but says it won’t use that data to train AI models or share it with others.

product_updates.title: Google’s latest AI weather model gives you no excuse to forget your umbrella
product_updates.content: WeatherNext 3 is the latest wave of a sea change in meteorology brought out by deep learning techniques. Google says it will start feeding into weather information users see in search, Google Maps, and Gemini.

product_updates.title: Nvidia confirms it will buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
product_updates.content: Nvidia said Hugging Face hosts over 3 million models and is used by over 18 million developers.
